new_entities.name: Knee joint (of flexible lower legform impactor)

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 8.1.1.2.
obligations.ears: When tested according to paragraph 8.1.1.4., the femur and the tibia of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 8.1.1.2.

derived.text: When tested according to paragraph 8.1.1.4., the femur of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 8.1.1.2.
When tested according to paragraph 8.1.1.4., the tibia of the flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 8.1.1.2.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 8.1.1.3.
obligations.ears: When tested according to paragraph 8.1.1.5., the knee joint of the lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements specified in paragraph 8.1.1.3.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: During the certification tests, the stabilized temperature of the impactor shall be 20° ± 2°C.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 4 kN for the applied external load
obligations.ears: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 4 kN for the applied external load.

derived.text: The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations.
The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 4 kN for the applied external load.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the applied moment and the generated deflection at the centre of the femur and the tibia (Mc and Dc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 22
obligations.ears: When the femur and the tibia of the impactor, without flesh and skin, are loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 8.1.1.4., the applied moment and the generated deflection at the centre of the femur and the tibia (Mc and Dc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 22.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 23
obligations.ears: When the knee joint of the impactor, without flesh and skin, is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 8.1.1.5., the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 23.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 24 and Figure 25
obligations.ears: The edges of the femur and tibia, without flesh and skin, not bending parts shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 24 and Figure 25.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be parallel to the loading axis within 180 ± 2° tolerance
obligations.ears: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within 180 ± 2° tolerance.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be applied at the centre of the femur and the tibia within ± 2mm tolerance along the Z-axis
obligations.ears: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the centre of the femur and the tibia within ± 2mm tolerance along the Z-axis.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part (Mc) of the femur or tibia reaches 380 Nm
obligations.ears: The force shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part (Mc) of the femur or tibia reaches 380 Nm.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 26
obligations.ears: The ends of the knee joint, without flesh and skin, shall be mounted to the support rig firmly as shown in Figure 26.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be parallel to the loading axis within ± 2° tolerance
obligations.ears: The Y-axis of the impactor shall be parallel to the loading axis within ± 2° tolerance.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: a foamed neoprene sheet shall be set between the loading ram and the impactor face of the knee joint, which is described in Figure 26, shall be removed
obligations.ears: To avoid impactor damage, a foamed neoprene sheet shall be set between the loading ram and the impactor face of the knee joint, which is described in Figure 26, shall be removed.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 15
obligations.ears: The foamed neoprene sheet used in this test shall have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 15.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be applied at the knee joint centre within ± 2°mm tolerance along the Z-axis (see Figure 12)
obligations.ears: The centre of the loading force shall be applied at the knee joint centre within ± 2°mm tolerance along the Z-axis (see Figure 12).

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part of the knee joint (Mc) reaches 400 Nm
obligations.ears: The external load shall be increased so as to maintain a deflection rate between 10 and 100 mm/minute until the bending moment at the centre part of the knee joint (Mc) reaches 400 Nm.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall meet the requirements according to paragraph 8.1.2.3.
obligations.ears: When tested as specified in paragraph 8.1.2.4., the assembled flexible lower legform impactor shall meet the requirements according to paragraph 8.1.2.3.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall have a stabilized temperature of 20 ± 2 °C during the test
obligations.ears: The test facility used for the certification test shall have a stabilized temperature of 20 ± 2 °C during the test.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall be measured at the time of certification and recorded in a certification report
obligations.ears: The temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification and recorded in a certification report.

derived.text: The temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification.
The temperature of the certification area shall be recorded in a certification report.
